scientific_scope_status: For preserved source B, a common controller restricted to the declared native generators cannot prepare a nontrivial hidden-parameter-independent terminal transition by any deterministic physical deadline. Continuous observation, switching, classical computation, private randomization, adaptive stopping and bounded-time heralding remain within the stated theorem. A common analytic continuation gives path signs fixed by terminal bipartite color; negative rates are proof devices only.

unavailable_or_unclassified: This is a menu-specific, ideal-boundary mathematical obstruction. Exact parameter access, new actuators, warranted baseline initialization/replacement and unbounded random hitting times remain allowed at their real costs. Endpoint-clock JOINT law must retain parameter dependence; the conditional endpoint-given-clock pattern need not itself vary. Retained controller state and reused seeds belong to the initial record or require independent future randomization. Decision latency must enter the actual kernel or be protected by an actual hold.
